name: NetMedia Group société anonyme
summary: NetMedia Group société anonyme specializes in conceiving, enhancing, structuring, and executing diverse communication solutions. Their services encompass digital platforms, social media engagement, brand-focused content creation, marketing campaigns, as well as traditional print and video production. They also provide expert consulting. Formerly operating as Makheia Group Société anonyme, the company adopted its current name in March 2023. Its headquarters are located in Boulogne-Billancourt, France.
